report:
## Conclusion

The evidence on whether hypnosis helps with smoking cessation is **mixed and inconclusive**. While some individual studies and clinics report high success rates, the most rigorous reviews paint a more cautious picture.

**Key findings:**

- The **Cochrane review** (Abbott, Stead, White & Barnes, 2010), considered the gold standard for evidence-based medicine, concluded: *"There is insufficient evidence to determine whether hypnotherapy is more effective for smoking cessation than other forms of behavioural support or unassisted quitting. If a benefit is present, current evidence suggests the benefit is small at most."* ([PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6568235/))

- A **2023 Frontiers meta-analysis** of hypnosis across health conditions found that for smoking cessation, effect sizes ranged from d = 0.12 to d = 0.84, but **only two of six effects were statistically significant**. ([Frontiers](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1330238/full))

- A **2024 randomized controlled trial** comparing hypnotherapy to cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) noted that *"the efficacy of hypnotherapy as a tobacco cessation intervention cannot be considered sufficiently proven due to significant methodological limitations in the studies available to date."* ([PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10929270/))

- Consumer health sources (WebMD, Healthline) note that study results are **mixed**, and hypnosis may help some people, especially when combined with other cessation programs, but more research is needed. ([WebMD](https://www.webmd.com/smoking-cessation/hypnosis-for-quitting-smoking))

**Bottom line:** Hypnosis is safe and may help some individuals quit smoking, particularly as part of a broader cessation plan. However, current scientific evidence does not conclusively show it is more effective than other established methods like CBT or nicotine replacement therapy. If you try hypnosis, it should complement—not replace—evidence-based approaches.
